description: Add pinned AWS CLI v2 and Google Workspace CLI tool installers.

userStories.title: Install AWS CLI v2 and Google Workspace CLI
userStories.description: As an operator, I want AWS CLI v2 and Google Workspace CLI installers so that I can add either tool without rebuilding.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `aws` and `gws` to `.agro/cli/src/lib/tools/catalog.ts` as installable, host-capable tools for the sandbox user.
Pin AWS CLI to `2.40.1` and Google Workspace CLI to `0.22.5`; verify each architecture-specific download with a recorded SHA-256 value.
Record SHA-256 values from both official HTTPS AWS release ZIPs; require no key material or cloud authentication.
Support Debian `amd64` and `arm64`; reject other architectures before downloading or writing installation files.
Install only below `${NPM_USER_PREFIX:-$HOME/.local}` without sudo; verify the installed executable by absolute path.
Install the AWS bundle below the prefix with `aws` and `aws_completer` launchers; reject missing `unzip` or unsupported whitespace paths before extraction.
Require the AWS executable to report the pinned v2 version; accept the documented two-line output of `gws --version`.
Remove only managed launchers and payloads during uninstall; preserve AWS and Google credentials and configuration.
Add failing tests before implementation for catalog discovery, architecture mapping, integrity failure, download failure, version failure, installation layout, and cleanup.
Extend command tests for both tools: help, list, status, host installation, repeat installation, failure propagation, and uninstall.
`pnpm exec vitest run .agro/cli/src/__tests__/tool-catalog.test.ts .agro/cli/src/__tests__/tool.test.ts` exits 0.
userStories.notes: Executed: advisor inspected all four changed files and integrated ef8235e0 as 8581a612. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and git diff HEAD^ HEAD --check exit 0. Main-checkout targeted Vitest exits 0: 2 files, 258 tests passed. Main-checkout pnpm run typecheck exits 0. Catalog and executable shell tests cover entry metadata, pins, both architecture mappings, unsupported architecture, prefix scope, unzip/whitespace, exact AWS v2 and multiline GWS verification, failures and temp cleanup, retry repair, credential-preserving removal. Command tests cover help/list/status, host receipts, sandbox no-op markers, failure propagation and uninstall. Worker artifact-integrity.md records official HTTPS ZIP digests and red-before-production test result (46 failed), with no keys/signature claim. Reasoned from inspected catalog: no sudo, cloud login, API, schema or boot changes.

userStories.title: Record isolated command evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a command transcript so that I can verify the user-facing install path without cloud credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: Record commands, observed output, exit status, and cleanup in `.agro/tasks/aws-gws-tool-install/evidence/manual-review.md`.
Start with a fresh temporary home and a workspace input path that does not exist; pass environment values inline and write no env file.
Run the built `agro` entry point to show help, list, install, status, repeat install, and uninstall for both tools.
Download and run both real amd64 executables through the isolated installation path; make no AWS or Google API request.
Record unsupported-architecture or integrity-failure behavior with an explicitly labeled offline fixture; never present a fixture as a real installation.
Preserve pre-existing installations and credentials; delete only temporary resources created by the evidence run.
userStories.notes: Executed: advisor read all 395 transcript lines and verified only the evidence file changed. Evidence records fresh initially absent workspace, temporary HOME/AGRO_HOME, inline environment and no env file; real built-CLI help/list/install/status/repeat-install/uninstall for AWS2.40.1 and GWS0.22.5; labeled unsupported-riscv64 failures with no receipts; cleanup and unchanged original AWS version/SHA256. Advisor independently reran real installs/status/no-op/removal for both tools through the built CLI in another fresh temporary home with unreachable Docker socket; monitor3 exit0. Asserted absent managed binaries/payload and no cloud config creation. Main-checkout STE manual-review exit0, git diff --check exit0. Reasoned from isolated paths and version-only invocations: no real credentials, keys, cloud API or original markers touched. Full repository lint/typecheck/build/tests also exit0: 120 files, 3228 tests passed, 2 skipped.
